newsitem.title: USA: Echo Bay to manage Americomm prospect.
newsitem.headline: Echo Bay to manage Americomm prospect.

text.p: Americomm Resources Corp said Tuesday Echo Bay Mines Ltd has tentatively agreed to manage exploration of Americomm's Jessup Gold Prospect in Churchill County, Nev.

Under the letter of intent, Echo Bay can earn a 51 percent interest in the property with scheduled cash payments totaling $750,000 to Americomm and work expenditures totaling $2,000,000 over a five year period, which may be accelerated at Echo Bay's option, Americomm said.
After earning its 51 percent interest in the property, Echo Bay may purchase an additional 19 percent interest.
This would require a payment of $2,000,000 to Americomm, the company said.
It said exploration will start this month.
The Jessup Property covers some 2,200 acres, held by 130 unpatented lode mining claims. Ninety-four of these claims were acquired by Americomm in 1995.
